# The product never runs these: E1.2 creation and the guard install are the attended host effect. Tests derive the
# launcher's expected network identity and guard-unit dependencies from these bytes; never edit them to fit code.
[e1.2-create]
  docker network create --driver bridge --subnet 10.231.65.0/24 --gateway 10.231.65.1 --ipv6=false \
    --opt com.docker.network.bridge.name=br-zeus-workers \
    --label zeus.owner=aibox-migration-001 --label zeus.role=workers zeus-workers
[guard-script-identity]
WORKERS_NET_NAME=zeus-workers
WORKERS_BRIDGE=br-zeus-workers
STORE_NET_NAME=zeus-aibox
OWNER_LABEL=aibox-migration-001
[guard-install]
  sudo install -o root -g root -m 0644 $P/zeus-aibox-network-guard.service /etc/systemd/system/zeus-aibox-network-guard.service
  systemctl show -p ActiveState,SubState,Result zeus-aibox-network-guard.service   # active/exited/success
[guard-unit]
[Unit]
Description=Zeus aibox network guard: zeus-workers public egress with private/host denial, zeus-aibox store ingress (W0 D5)
After=docker.service docker-user-fw.service
Requires=docker.service
PartOf=docker.service docker-user-fw.service

[Service]
Type=oneshot
RemainAfterExit=yes
EnvironmentFile=/etc/default/zeus-aibox-network-guard
ExecStart=/usr/local/sbin/zeus-network-guard.sh install

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target docker.service docker-user-fw.service
